name: OpenVibe.Codes
notes: Port 4900, unit openvibe-codes.service, state /var/lib/openvibe-codes. The developer portal (ADR-014): projects, members, apps, credentials, grants and quotas are OWNED BY NETWORK and shown through Network's /api/v1/projects API with the signed-in person's own token; Codes stores none of them and never a secret. Codes owns only manifests, releases (+ append-only release_log), trust tiers (metadata) and playground run logs in its own SQLite. Consumes OpenVibe.Network (SSO with PKCE S256 as OAuth client codes, JWKS, the projects API, the registry, client-credentials) and publishes through OpenVibe.Events (events.event.publish). Playgrounds call Events and Media with the APP's own token only. Docs are generated at boot from the pinned openvibe-contracts and openvibe-sdk.
